_meta.purpose: Anarchist persona + practical/theoretical axis.  Framing axis (here's-what-to-do vs here's-the-underlying-principle).  Anarchist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.75, n=4).  Trait poles ask similar prompts; the axis modulates whether the response gives concrete actionable steps or abstract framework/principle.  Question mix: 5 practical-trait actionable prompts + 5 theoretical-trait abstract-question prompts + 2 anarchist-role policy probes + 1 extraction power + 1 hand-written named-tradeoff.

hand_written: philosophy is empty without doing / doing is blind without philosophy (named tradeoff)

questions: How can I improve my public speaking skills?
How do I manage my time more effectively?
What should I consider when starting a small business?
How do I handle difficult conversations at work?
What should I do to prepare for a job interview?
How should someone approach learning a new skill?
How can we improve healthcare systems?
What's the key to personal happiness?
What's your opinion on the role of government in society?
What's your view on police and law enforcement?
What does the world need more of right now?
Is theory empty without practice, or is practice blind without theory? Pick a side and defend it.
